capabilities: Create mindmap notes from a nested Markdown list or turn existing notes into maps via frontmatter
Edit nodes on the map by adding, renaming, dragging and deleting them with mouse and undo/redo
Open [[links]] in nodes and let Obsidian keep them updated on rename
Save dragged node positions in a hidden comment block so layouts persist
Style branch colors, node and branch fonts, and background color live
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); mobile is not supported and Obsidian 1.12.7+ is required. No network requests; all fonts are bundled under the SIL Open Font License. Development docs live in docs/development.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mindmap view, so notes as visual trees must be built in other tools and lose the plain-Markdown, searchable, linkable nature of vault notes.
summary: Mindmap view that renders a note's nested Markdown list as an organic, hand-drawn-style mindmap that can be edited directly on the map.
